value: Carevin hears the account and does not claim he can end the worgen problem. He will make containing their numbers a priority, while the root of the trouble remains beyond the household’s reach. That is the local resolution the quest supports: a promise to resist a danger, not a cure, a recovered weapon, or a verdict on every cause shaping Duskwood. The trail now returns to Darnassus, where Thyn’tel can hear what the mound revealed.
editorNote: Attribution and evidential limits remain explicit in the transcript. This claim is based on a secondary transcription; original-client comparison remains open.
